$comment: Kontrolný výkaz DPH (§ 78a zákona o DPH): XML layout and filling rules by validity date. The layout follows the published XSD of Finančná správa as known to the authors; it could not be checked against the official schema file when this was written, so every version stays verified=false until an accountant and the XSD confirm it. Thresholds come from the filling instructions (poučenie) and the methodical guideline (metodický pokyn).
